title: Engineer NPQ
description:
Lead quality assurance activities during new product development, ensuring adherence to quality standards and specifications.
- Conduct detailed inspections and tests on new products to verify compliance with design and regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate with design and production teams to identify potential quality risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
- Develop and maintain quality documentation, including test plans, reports, and procedures.
- Analyze quality-related data and trends to drive corrective actions and process improvements.
- Support training initiatives for team members on quality standards and best practices. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
  -Co-ordinate and manage the quality assurance activities in new product development projects to ensure internal & customer requirements.
- Lead quality planning activities by preparing Control Plans, PFMEA inputs, Process Standards, Setup Verification, Layout Inspection, MSA, SPC, PBTR, AOI, Packing Proposals, and PSW documentation.
- Co-ordinate with CFT for Try-out and validation.
- Perform Initial analysis and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
- Critical Test for new product and Sample part inspection
- New product Customer handling
- Preparing OPL, Q-alert preparation & display
- Ensure horizontal deployment of corrective actions across similar products and processes while monitoring their effectiveness.
- New Product Stage Wise control verification, Based on past trouble data base (Proto/PPAP/Mass Production).
- Prepare weekly and monthly quality performance reports, project status updates, and management review presentations.
- Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives through QA Matrix, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) techniques.
- Customer, and third-party quality audits handling by ensuring documentation compliance and timely closure of audit observations.
- Knowledge in concept development on design and Development

Key Skills: Data Validation,NPD,EEE,New Product Development,Continuous Improvement,Poka Yoke,Process,Control Plan
